title: importJob
description: Report on the execution of an import job.

id.description: Unique identifier for the import job report.

channelName.description: The name of the channel at the time of logging the import job.

channelId.description: UUID referencing the channel configuration that governed the import job run.

importType.description: Type of import job (obsolete, always bulk XML).

transformation.description: Then name for the transformation pipeline used for the job.

status.description: The intermittent state or final outcome of the job.

amountImported.description: The number of incoming records processed.

message.description: A description of the outcome of the import.

metadata.description: For tagging records with current time and user ID on create or update.

createdDate.description: Time stamp for the records creation.

createdByUserId.description: ID of the user creating the record.

updatedDate.description: Time stamp for the most recent update of the record.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who most recently updated the record.
